description: Canonical expansion-aware representation derived from all_products_api.json. Source presence is evidence for inventory membership, not proof of runtime availability.

identity.canonicalId: stable product-scoped identifier; prefer Id when present, otherwise Product + FullName
identity.name: source Name

verification.evidence: structured evidence objects recorded in later verification stages
verification.build: target/source build identifier when independently established

examplePolicy.basic: allowed only when verificationStatus=verified and availabilityStatus=verified-available
examplePolicy.moderate: allowed only when verificationStatus=verified and availabilityStatus=verified-available
